class.name: NNFloatRangeSensor
class.brief_description: Maps a [float] value within a min/max range into [code]0..1[/code].
class.description: Linearly maps [member range_value] between [member range_min_value] ([code]0.0[/code]) and [member range_max_value] ([code]1.0[/code]), clamped to [code]0..1[/code]. Use this for continuous stats such as health, stamina, speed, or temperature.

members.member: Upper bound of the range, mapping to [code]1.0[/code].
Lower bound of the range, mapping to [code]0.0[/code].
Current input value, clamped to [member range_min_value]..[member range_max_value].
